# Recommended Reading

Books and resources for deeper learning on bootstrapped SaaS.

| Book | Author | Topic |
| ---- | ------ | ----- |
| The Mom Test | Rob Fitzpatrick | Customer interviews |
| Obviously Awesome | April Dunford | Positioning |
| Zero to Sold | Arvid Kahl | Bootstrapped SaaS journey |
| Traction | Gabriel Weinberg | Distribution channels |
| MAKE | Pieter Levels | Indie maker approach |
| Start Small, Stay Small | Rob Walling | Developer entrepreneurship |

Full resource guide: https://github.com/merklefruit/SaaS4Devs
